lede: Technic Autocare is a car workshop in Soon Lee Street (Pioneer Point). Its own website lists general servicing and repairs, accident claims and repairs, engine diagnostics and tune-up and aircon services.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention servicing with plug and filter changes, troubleshooting a car problem on a walk-in, and repairs finished within a day.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, technicautocare.com.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
